images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Make a single full-body transparent Chibi game character sprite of Wynonna Fiachrach, Carys Draig's mother, facing three-quarters LEFT, as if she just strode in from screen-right. Image 1 is Wynonna's exact canon portrait: her deep chestnut swept-back long hair, dark brown eyes, gold drop earrings and bracelets, elegant forest-green dress with distinctive gold Celtic embroidery and muted green-gold plaid sash. Continue that same dress to practical floor-length hem, small refined shoes just visible, no armor. She is a recognizable mature adult mother, chibi proportioned. Image 2 is strict style reference only: reproduce the detailed outline work, crisp matte cel shading, compact chibi shape language and color treatment of this fantasy game's Einion sheet, without copying his hair, eyes or costume. Warm directional window light from screen-left.

One lively storytelling pose, visible head to feet: Wynonna visibly stern with pinched eyebrows and mouth open in a scolding expression. One hand firmly on hip, other firmly gesturing to screen-LEFT towards Carys with a raised warning forefinger, balanced one step into the room. Her dark hair and green skirt show a tiny natural sweep following her entry. Emphasize her recognizable face and elegant dark green and gold silhouette, restrained humor and no threat. No dialogue, props, runes, decorative panels, watermark, setting, ground shadow or effects. Genuine isolated transparency around the entire figure with generous margins and no clipped hand, hair or hem. Single standalone sprite, not a grid.
